description: Election Commission - Declare that T. Sharanga as a member of the Alayadivembu Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Alayadivembu Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's absence from meetings. It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member. This content falls squarely within electoral processes and local authority member changes, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette.
